**[JAK inhibitor therapy in CANDLE syndrome: a systematic review of clinical outcomes in 46 patients.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42547647/)** *(from Pediatric rheumatology/autoinflammatory disease)*

Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `JAK-STAT, AGS-spectrum, treatment-target`

DOI: 10.1007/s00431-026-07293-8
